usedFor: CalendarHero holds meeting requests and contacts, and Conversion Chats receives a message through “Send Template Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting Request Is Created” in CalendarHero, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A new meeting request is the moment to confirm, and the action sends a template message.

watchOut: “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats uses a template, so choose it and map the recipient in the step.
